svg.title: Sheet 4b — The Zone, week 3: front and back on one page (127 x 104 mm)
svg.desc: Split off sheet 4 on purpose. The grid on sheet 4 is live from week 1, but Learn/Teach and the Ledger's Capability/Shared Practice payoff don't exist before week 3 - so this panel sits face-down beside sheet 4 until week 3, then turns over alongside the Ledger. Cut both panels out, glue them to opposite faces of one piece of 2 mm greyboard. Print at 100% on one side of one sheet.
svg.text: SHEET 4b · THE ZONE, CONTINUED · BOTH FACES ON THIS PAGE · PRINT AT 100%
turn this up at the start of week 3

g.text: HOW YOU COVER
LEARN
pick up a new tool, left or right
of one you cover, in your own row. No teacher needed.
TEACH
let someone cover a square you hold - up, down,
left or right of one they cover, in any row.
Always one step from what you already cover, never a diagonal leap -
Vygotsky's Zone of Proximal Development.
THE LEDGER READS THIS
CAPABILITY · A FULL LINE
fill any whole row or whole column
SHARED PRACTICE · A STACK
two of you covering the same square
One step a week, as ever. A column can only be filled by teaching.
BOURDIEU 1986 · FORMS OF CAPITAL · VYGOTSKY 1978 · ZONE OF PROXIMAL DEV./SCAFF. · MARX 1846

svg.text: this is the side showing while it sits beside sheet 4

g.text: TURN ME OVER
START OF WEEK 3
The Zone has more to it than the grid.
Covering a square is only half of it - what you do with a
square you already cover comes next.
ALSO NOW: THE LEDGER FLIPS TO ITS FRONT

svg.text: Cut both panels out, glue them to opposite faces of one piece of 2 mm greyboard -
Face A and Face B on the same board. Stand it beside sheet 4 with Face B showing,
and turn it over in place at the start of week 3.
